claims.statement: Ditched cultivation at Kuk: approximately 2400–2030 BCE.
Later farmers at Kuk used ditches to cultivate wet ground. The research dates the beginning of this phase to about 2400–2030 BCE.
Kuk archaeological site reference. This is a reference position, not a territorial boundary.
